Highlighted: selected range (season 2025/26); ○ = peak week of each season

g.text: Linear view, 2012-2026. Shaded band = selected time range, highlighted in the cyclic view.
○ with label = peak ISO week of each season (W40-W39)

No: up to 2018/19 the peak fell every season in a narrow window (ISO weeks 5-9, Feb-Mar), but since the COVID-19 pandemic its timing has scattered (peak weeks by season: W12, W39, W11, W50, W50, W07, W06).
Data: Robert Koch-Institut, ARE-Praxis-Sentinel (ARE-Konsultationsinzidenz), Bundesweit, all ages; CC BY 4.0.
Does acute respiratory illness in Germany peak at the same time every year?
